newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures cut losses, end mixed.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures cut losses, end mixed.

text.p: May 5 - IMM currency futures cut losses late, ended mixed. Yen, sterling each erased losses on very light turnover after earlier lack of downside followthrough. Canadian dollar rose as one firm bought about 500 June in the closing range. Market waited for UK, Japan to return Tuesday from holiday. Many foresee more currency downside soon.
